name: Compiler Tooling Inflection-Architecture Coverage
description: Bundle 6 substantive coverage gaps + 1 close-out for compiler tooling specifically designed around Inflection-architecture patterns (Lambda-bundled silver scripts, multi-firm shared infrastructure, marker-constant contracts spread across 30+ files, EventBridge S3-event chains, 9-dim quorum). Goal: get compiler tooling ahead of the architecture rather than chasing each gap reactively. Anchored on 6 same-week incidents + Andrew 2026-05-08 exchange 'are our compilers adequately designed for the inflection pipeline'.

prds.label: ADHC_COMPIL_V4 PRD v0.1 + v0.2 + v0.3 addenda

source_brief: 1.0.0_SA_CTO architectural assessment 2026-05-08 + 6 anchor incidents from same-week Inflection sprint (INFETL.CHAININC, AUDIT-003 partial-coverage, INFNNA rep_id=6 sync, ROUTER-DRIFT false-drift, FIRMSEP.02 layer-mismatch, DAILY-AUDIT hand-authoring) + Andrew direct: 'are our compilers adequately designed for the inflection pipeline'
phase: Phase 1 EXECUTION — v0.2 ADDENDUM SHIPPED 2026-05-08 PM. 2 of 11 P1 TOs + 3 SEED TOs SHIPPED. **PRD v0.2 addendum** (CTO 2026-05-08 PM post 2-week retrospective scan) adds 4 new TOs covering 4 substantive gaps not in v0.1: TO-8 comp-pipescript Inflection-graph extension (1d), TO-9 comp-validate Orion config support (0.75d), TO-10 comp-platinum reverse authoritative-only mode (0.5d), TO-11 comp-transform schema-check robustness (0.75d). TO-3 (comp-constants) is precursor to TO-8 + TO-9 (Andrew direct: 'comp-constants would help a lot as a precursor to a lot of this'). 4 TO files distributed to AE 0.7 task_orders by CTO direct (Andrew delegation). CTO wave SHIPPED `bf9f8b8fa`. DS SEED wave SHIPPED CLEAN 2026-05-08T~14:30Z. AE wave (TO-1/3/4/5/6/8/9/10/11/VAL) queued post FIRMSEP P2 .07. Combined Phase 1 effort: ~7.5 effort-days.
blocking: AE 0.7 bandwidth — saturated on FIRMSEP Phase 2 (.07/.08/.09) + INFETL.011 first-fire empirical witness 2026-05-09 06:00 UTC. COO queued TO-1/3/4/6 for dispatch after FIRMSEP P2 .07 ships; TO-5 (park-and-resume) last; v0.2 TOs TO-8/9 gate on TO-3 ship; TO-10/11 ship parallel anywhere post-Wave 1. SEED TOs (DS~B/~C/~D) all SHIPPED; AE TOs unblocked. CTO wave clean.
depends_on_note: Independent project. Cross-coordinates with ADVI_INFETL (TO-5 auto-renders the DAILY-AUDIT matrix), ADVI_INFNNA (TO-3 indexes INFLECTION_REP_IDS), ADVI_FIRMSEP (TO-6 reuses the cross-firm view that FIRMSEP.10 Cottonwood onboarding will need).
